DATED: 02  
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR QUASHING & SET ASIDE  FIR/ORDER) NO. 2582 of 2026  ==========================================================
 MITUL @AMIT S/O. BHAGVANDAS PATEL & ORS.
 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR N P CHAUDHARY(3980) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4  MS. KRINA P. CALLA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE VIMAL K. VYAS  Date : 02/03/2026

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. Learned advocate Mr. C.R. Buddhadev appears and submits that he has instructions to appear on behalf of the respondent no.2 - original complainant.
He is permitted to file his appearance.
Registry shall accept his vakalatnama.

2. By way of preferring the present application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the applicants-accused seek to invoke the inherent powers of this Court, praying to quash and set-aside the First Information Report being I-C.R. No. 145 of 2018 registered with 'A'
Division Police Station, Rajkot City, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 114 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as the chargesheet and the proceedings of the Criminal Case No. 14695 of 2018 pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/2582/2026 ORDER DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined Magistrate, Rajkot, so also all other consequential proceedings arising pursuant thereto.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Today, when the matter is called out, the complainant, who is personally present before this Court, has produced his identity proof as well as submitted an affidavit.
The same are ordered to be taken on record.

In the said affidavit, the complainant has categorically stated that with the intervention of the friends, family members and community people, the dispute has been amicably resolved with the applicants and there is no ill-will or any grievance amongst them.

4. Considering the issue involved in the present application as well as considering the fact that the dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties, with the consent of the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, the present application is taken up for final disposal.
5. RULE returnable forthwith.

Learned APP Ms. Krina Calla waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.1 - State and learned advocate Mr. C.R. Buddhadev waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.2 - complainant.

6. Learned advocate for the applicants-accused has submitted that since the dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties, the application may be allowed and the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/2582/2026 ORDER DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined impugned FIR, the charge-sheet and the proceedings of the Criminal Case may be quashed and set-aside.

7. The complainant, who is personally present in the Court, has categorically stated before this Court that he has no objection if the application is allowed and the impugned FIR, the charge-sheet and the proceedings of the Criminal Case are quashed and set-aside.
Thus, it appears from the aforesaid that sending the applicants-accused to face the trial would be nothing but a futile exercise and would amount to abuse of process of law.

8. The relevant paragraphs of the affidavit filed by the complainant - Ketanbhai Govindbhai Tanti (Patel) read thus :
"1. I say and submit that complaint First Information Report bearing First Information Report bearing C.R. No. 1-145/2018 registered with 'A' Division Police Station, Rajkot filed by me on 23.07.2018 for the alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code against the applicants.
2.
I, however, say and submit that now amicable settlement has been arrived at.

I,
therefore, say and submit that because of above fact; I do not want to proceed further with the proceeding arising out of the impugned FIR.

I, therefore, say and submit that because of amicable settlement arrived at between the parties, now I am giving my consent for quashing of the impugned FIR and subsequent proceeding and I have no objection if the impugned FIR and subsequent proceeding is quashed and set aside.
I further say and submit that I am ready and willing to remain present before this Hon'ble Court in the case of necessity 3.
I state that I Received Rs.5,50000.00 for the price of Air condition machine.

Mitul @Amit S/O. Bhagvandas Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 2 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97502953/
2
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/2582/2026 ORDER DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined

4. I further state that now settlement arrived between us so complaint bearing C.R.
No. 1-145/2018 registered with 'A' Division Police Station, Rajkot filed by me on 23.07.2018 for the alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 406,420, and 114 of the Indian Penal Code against present applicants filed by me here in i.e. the original complainant on 23.07.2018 and subsequent proceedings arising out of the F.I.R. is required to be quashed and set aside by this Hon'ble Court."

9. Having heard learned advocates appearing for the respective parties as well as considering the facts and circumstances arising out of the present application and taking into consideration the decisions rendered in the cases of Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Another, reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, Madan Mohan Abbot vs. State of Punjab, reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, Nikhil Merchant vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Another, reported in (2009) 1 GLH 31, Manoj Sharma vs. State & Others, reported in (2009) 1 GLH 190, and Narinder Singh & Others vs. State of Punjab &
Another, reported in (2014) 2 Crime 67 (SC) as well as State of Haryana vs. Bhajanlal, reported in AIR 1992 SC 604, it appears that further continuation of the criminal proceedings in relation to the impugned FIR, the charge-sheet and the Criminal Case against the applicants-accused would be nothing but unnecessary harassment to the applicants-accused.

10.
In the result, the application is allowed.

The First Information Report being I-C.R. No. 145 of 2018 registered with 'A' Division Police Station, Rajkot City, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 114 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as the chargesheet and the proceedings of the Criminal Case No. 14695 of 2018 pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
